verdict.rationale: Stable has a public pricing page listing plan inclusions such as basic mail actions (scan, ship, shred), one street address, user limits, API and webhooks, AI summaries, and a 30-day money-back guarantee. Marketing pages also describe 'free high-res scans' and forwarding with 'discounted rates included'. None of the cited evidence shows actual dollar figures, so the completeness the story asks for is unproven. missing for 10: monthly plan price, numeric scan allowances, per-item fees for extra scans, forwarding/shipping fees, storage fees, check deposit fees.
